subject: Fix SIGSEGV in LatencySampler when hdr_init fails (#1230)
reason: The fix only changes behaviour when hdr_init fails inside LatencySampler::SubmitSample. In the shipped module every LatencySampler is constructed with hard-coded valid parameters (min=1ns, max=1s, precision=2 in src/metrics.h), so hdr_init can only fail on calloc returning NULL inside the module process — a condition no installed fuzzer component can induce on a real server (maxmemory does not constrain libc allocations, and there is no allocation-fault injector).
